stack.components_note: One entry per part of the product that gets built. `kind` is free text -- frontend, backend, desktop-app, cli, service, library, mobile-app, pipeline. `implemented_by` names the Workflow 3 role that builds it.
stack.decision_source: Human decision 2026-09-17: backend = Python (FastAPI), frontend = React (web SPA), NLU/LLM layer = AWS Bedrock foundation models. The two data-store technologies (SQLite, Chroma) were already fixed upstream during Requirements (PRD v1.5 Section 13, Gate 2 decision) and are carried here unchanged, not re-decided.

constraints.source: Human decision 2026-09-17: no budget ceiling applies -- internal demo/hackathon project on seeded data, not a cost-constrained production deployment.

task.scope_source: Human decision 2026-09-17: architect the full product in one pass (all 7 PRD features / 21 stories) rather than a sub-slice, since this is a small single-persona demo product, not a large speculative platform.

workflow_signoff.owner_note: Sign-off is cross-cutting and belongs to whoever drives the workflow, not to one specialist.
